rows.headline: Tenant evicted because unregistered rent agreement fails to provide legal protection
rows.hook: No legal cover under unregistered rent contracts
rows.summary: A tenant faced eviction after the landlord terminated the lease, relying on an unregistered rent agreement that holds no statutory legal value in disputes. Under Indian registration laws, rent agreements exceeding 11 months must be formally registered to be admissible as evidence in court. This leaves tenants vulnerable to sudden eviction or arbitrary rent hikes without legal recourse. Retail investors owning rental properties must ensure proper documentation, while tenant-investors risk sudden disruptions if leases lack formal registration.
rows.why_it_matters: Ensure formal registration for rental properties to avoid legal disputes.
